{{Quote|Repair these droids so we can use them for target practice...again.|The soldier talking to R2-D2|<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>}}
This '''Mandalorian''' was part of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] terrorist organization and was stationed in a [[Death Watch camp|camp]] on the snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
After junior senator [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] arrived on the planet of Carlac along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to deliver a [[Holotrace device/Legends|holotrace device]] with the location of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to the Mandalorian terrorist organization known as the Death Watch, the three were lead by the Mandalorians into their campsite.

After Lux Bonteri spoke with Death Watch leader [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and handed him the holotrace, this soldier along with a fellow one took R2-D2 to a tent which contained various broken droids and ordered him to repair them so they can use them for target practice again.

The soldier and the rest of the Death Watch were later seen attacking the [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] [[Ming Po town|town]] under orders from Pre Vizsla and after the identity of Ahsoka Tano was revealed, the soldiers along with the Death watch members fought R2-D2s repaired [[Monster droid/Legends|junk droid]] squadron.
